text: SOLIZE Holdings Corporation is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, Standard Market (stock code 5871). Per its FY2025 annual securities report, summarised by J-LiC, its largest shareholders are the SOLIZE employee stock-ownership association (21.08%), Miyuki Furukawa (14.09%), Keiichi Shinohara (6.44%) and Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co. (5.6%).
short: SOLIZE Holdings is TSE-listed (5871); top holder is its employee stock association
